result.stdout:
codemap - package repositories into AI-friendly output

Usage:
  codemap [options]

Source:
  --remote <url|owner/repo>     Clone a remote Git repository
  --remote-branch <branch>      Branch to clone

Selection:
  --include <patterns>          Comma-separated include globs
  --ignore <patterns>           Comma-separated ignore globs
  --max-file-size <bytes>       Skip larger files
  --config <path>               Configuration JSON file

Output:
  --format <xml|markdown|json|plain>
  --output <path>               Output file (default: codemap-output.md)
  --no-summary                  Omit summary metadata
  --no-tree                     Omit directory structure
  --split-output <bytes>        Split large output into numbered files

Transformations and limits:
  --security-check              Exclude files with DevSkim findings
  --remove-comments             Remove common source comments
  --remove-empty-lines          Remove blank lines
  --line-numbers                Add line numbers
  --token-budget <count>        Fail when rendered output exceeds count

Git and workflow:
  --include-diffs               Include git diff
  --include-logs                Include recent git commits
  --include-logs-count <count>  Number of commits (default: 20)
  --watch                       Report source changes
  --version                     Show the tool version
  --help                       Show this help

Examples:
  codemap --format markdown --output repository.md
  codemap --include "**/*.cs" --security-check
  codemap --remote microsoft/generative-ai-for-beginners --remote-branch main

More documentation: README.md
